name: settings.battery.long_mode_click_data
evidence: The page builder registers event code 7 on the long-endurance control with user data 1. Its callback obtains that data via the shared getter, then invokes the event-target getter and handles the control only if the data equals 1. That branch queries the switch state and triggers the corresponding long-mode handling. The page root is cleared by cleanup.
scope: the user-data getter call in the battery long-endurance control callback while the battery page root is active
limitations: Overriding this value with anything except 1 bypasses this callback branch, but the switch may already have changed visually; refresh or reconcile UI state separately. This does not stop other mechanisms from changing long-endurance mode. Shared-entry publication and rollback need system-wide quiescence; device behavior is unverified.
registration_evidence: Event registration uses object, callback, code 7 and user data 1; its result is ignored by the caller.
